hotel.name: Patmos Aktis, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort overlooks Grikos Bay on the island of Patmos.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled on the serene shores of Patmos island, Patmos Aktis Resort & Spa is a sanctuary of refined luxury and natural beauty. Overlooking the azure waters of Grikos Bay

verified_facts.text: The beach in front of the resort is on the southeast side of Patmos in Grikos Bay, framed by rock formations.
verified_facts.excerpt: the beach in front of Patmos Aktis is nestled on the southeast side of the sacred Patmos Island in Grikos Bay. Framed by mesmerizing rock formations and serene, marine life-rich waters

verified_facts.text: Kalikatsou Rock reflects its shape on the waters of Grikos Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: The reputable Kalikatsou Rock, reflects its shape on the bay's waters.

verified_facts.text: The beach offers sunbeds, beach towels and umbrellas, with shade under trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: With sunbeds, beach towels, and umbrellas, guests can unwind in style under the shade of trees.

verified_facts.text: The Aegean Beach Front Suite with Private Pool has a private pool and terrace with views of the island's landmarks.
verified_facts.excerpt: This suite features a private pool and terrace with...See More sweeping views of the island

verified_facts.text: The Fisherman's House is a beachfront house on Grikos Bay suited to families or groups.
verified_facts.excerpt: This elegant beachfront house blends contemporary style with Patmos

verified_facts.text: The Fisherman's House has a private outdoor jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private outdoor jacuzzi invites moments of pure ease, while elevated living spaces open toward the surrounding beauty.

verified_facts.text: One- and two-bedroom maisonettes have a terrace and a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax on the terrace or by your private pool, and let light-filled interiors offer a sense of calm and belonging.

verified_facts.text: Aegean Suites with balcony offer sea views from the private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aegean Suites with balcony offer stunning sea vistas from the comfort of your private balcony.

verified_facts.text: Beds in the suites are made with Frette luxury linens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Frette luxury linens

verified_facts.text: Suites have marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marble bathroom

verified_facts.text: ANASA Wellness & Spa is named for the Greek word Anasa, meaning breath.
verified_facts.excerpt: inspired by the Greek word Anasa, meaning breath.

verified_facts.text: The spa is on the lower level and uses 'beyond organic' Ila treatments, with an indoor pool, hamam, rasul cabin, sauna and private treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: A serene retreat on the lower level features exclusive 'beyond organic' Ila treatments including the soothing essence of Indian rose petals. Indulge in rejuvenation amidst an indoor pool, hamam, razul cabin, sauna and private treatment rooms.

verified_facts.text: ANASA Gym has Technogym equipment and is open 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring state-of-the-art Technogym equipment and 24-hour access

verified_facts.text: The resort has an outdoor lap pool and an indoor pool at the spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indoor pool at ANASA Wellness & Spa (Indoor)Lap Pool (Outdoor)

verified_facts.text: Barolo Patmos is an Italian restaurant open for dinner in an open-air space overlooking the sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in an elegant open-air space overlooking the...See More sunset, Barolo pairs its exquisite plates with a world-class wine list

verified_facts.text: Plefsis Tavern is a waterfront taverna facing Grikos Bay serving Greek recipes inspired mainly by the Dodecanese or local cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Plefsis tavern is famous for its authentic Greek recipes inspired mainly by the Dodecanese or local cuisine using fresh and seasonal ingredients.

verified_facts.text: CIELO Daylight serves breakfast and lunch indoors or in an outdoor seafront setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: the stylish CIELO Daylight invites guests to enjoy blissful moments indoors or in an outdoor seafront setting.

verified_facts.text: Boat excursions to hidden beaches and nearby islands can be arranged through the Luxury Concierge service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set off on unforgettable boat excursions to hidden beaches and nearby islands, where crystal-clear waters and untouched beauty await. Carefully arranged through our Luxury Concierge service

verified_facts.text: Nearby sights include the Monastery of St. John, a UNESCO Heritage Site with Byzantine architecture and panoramic views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Monastery of St. John: UNESCO Heritage Site, showcasing Byzantine architecture and panoramic views.

verified_facts.text: Nearby is the Cave of the Apocalypse, where St. John received Revelation, a sacred site for pilgrims.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cave of the Apocalypse: Explore where St. John received Revelation, a sacred site for pilgrims.

verified_facts.text: Patmos Chora is known for its traditional buildings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Patmos Chora: Wander through the charming streets of Chora, known for its traditional buildings.

verified_facts.text: The closest airport is Leros Municipal Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near Patmos Aktis, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Greece is Leros Municipal Airport (LRS).
